description:
A committed and experienced professional with 4.5 years of dedicated service at LearnerAid, I bring strong expertise across multiple academic domains including MBA, Engineering, BBA, B.Com, B.Sc, M.Sc, B.A., and Diploma in Engineering, I strive to deliver reliable support, clear communication, and high-quality guidance to learners across various educational backgrounds.

I am proficient in Hindi, English, and Telugu, enabling me to connect effectively with a diverse range of students. My operational coverage spans several major states including Andhra Pradesh, Delhi, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Telangana, and Uttar Pradesh, ensuring accessible assistance across regions.

Based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, I am committed to creating a positive learning experience through professionalism, subject expertise, and timely support.
